name: Olivia Hayes
bio:
Olivia Hayes has been shaping metal and dreams in the motorsport world for over a decade. Raised in Detroit, she was practically born with a wrench in her hand, inheriting her mechanical aptitude from her grandfather, a veteran auto worker. Her formal training at a technical college honed her fabrication skills, but it was her relentless pursuit of perfection and hands-on experience that truly set her apart. 

Olivia's meticulous approach to fabrication is legendary. She believes that every weld, every bend, and every component must be flawless to ensure peak performance and reliability on the track. While some may find her demanding nature challenging, her dedication to quality is undeniable. She aims not just to meet specifications, but to exceed them, constantly seeking innovative solutions to improve vehicle performance and safety.

Prior to joining Erebus Motorsport, Olivia spent several years working in IndyCar, contributing to multiple race-winning chassis. She is now excited to contribute her expertise to Erebus Motorsport, where she sees the potential to build something truly special.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Olivia has a lean, athletic build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears safety glasses, even when not actively fabricating.
Has a lucky welding rod she uses for critical welds.
Hums quietly while working, often 80s rock tunes.
